intents.name: Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters logo
intents.specification: PNG, alpha, Use the largest available master; do not upscale a thumbnail.
intents.acceptance: Logo edges clean at end-card size; proportions and colour match the supplied master.

intents.name: Easy Pour Mixed Bag pack
intents.specification: JPEG, 1800x1800, Crop only to the pack edge; do not crop the front label.
intents.acceptance: Front title, ‘Light to Dark Roasts’ and Blue Tokai mark readable at phone scale; no label crop.

intents.name: Easy Pour Vienna pack
intents.specification: JPEG, 1800x1800, Front pack only; keep the roast descriptor visible.
intents.acceptance: Vienna name and dark-roast descriptor readable; no label crop.

intents.name: Easy Pour Attikan Estate pack
intents.specification: JPEG, 1800x1800, Front pack only; keep the roast descriptor visible.
intents.acceptance: Attikan name and medium-dark descriptor readable; no label crop.

intents.name: Easy Pour Seethargundu Estate pack
intents.specification: JPEG, 1800x1800, Front pack only; keep the light-roast descriptor visible.
intents.acceptance: Seethargundu name and light-roast descriptor readable; no label crop.

intents.name: Easy Pour brewing demonstration, hands
intents.specification: ProRes 422 HQ, 3840x2160, 25 fps, 170 frames, Shoot 4K for a 1080p master crop; 180-degree shutter.
intents.acceptance: Tear, open and anchor actions are physically correct and match the brand instructions.

intents.name: Hot water pour and bloom footage
intents.specification: ProRes 422 HQ, 3840x2160, 50 fps, 140 frames, Source timebase 50 fps; conform to the 25 fps master at 50 percent speed.
intents.acceptance: Water visibly contacts the coffee bed; bloom and drip read in macro; no spill or continuity break.

intents.name: Warm kitchen background
intents.acceptance: Full-canvas background holds a consistent grade across all six shots.

intents.name: Finished cup of coffee
intents.specification: ProRes 422 HQ, 3840x2160, 25 fps, 90 frames, Shoot 4K; keep the cup rim and coffee surface in focus.
intents.acceptance: Finished cup matches the brewed colour; rim clean; steam visible without obscuring the pack.

intents.name: Voice over, warm Indian English
intents.specification: WAV, 25 fps, 500 frames, 48 kHz, 24-bit, dry studio recording; full 20-second read.
intents.acceptance: Performer release present; intelligible read; no claim beyond the canonical script.

intents.name: Music bed, 20 seconds
intents.specification: WAV, 25 fps, 500 frames, 48 kHz, 24-bit, instrumental, loopable tail.
intents.acceptance: Licence covers paid YouTube; 20-second edit supports the 275 range lift and 445 resolve.

intents.name: Water pour sound effect
intents.acceptance: Pour sound syncs to the water action without a phasing artefact.

intents.name: Brand sting
intents.acceptance: Sting lands under the end card and does not mask the VO.

intents.name: Captured Mixed Bag fallback
intents.specification: PNG, 2400x2400, Front label square to camera; four angles.
intents.acceptance: Physical pack label is square to camera and at least as legible as the supplied image.

intents.name: Music fallback track
intents.acceptance: Fallback bed matches the primary tempo and emotional resolve.

intents.name: Synthetic narration fallback
intents.acceptance: Synthetic read matches the canonical script and carries the disclosure decision.

capture.studio: Self-operated location with phone/DSLR and practical light (lean mode)
capture.colour_target: Warm 3200K practical light, neutral grade, no baked look
capture.audio_rig: Close-mic foley plus 30 seconds of room tone
capture.acceptance: Tear, anchor and pour are visible in one continuous take; the pack label stays legible; the finished cup shows live steam.

cues.description: Canonical read: Specialty coffee. Tear, anchor, pour. Just a mug and hot water. Light to dark. One mug. One cup. Shop Easy Pour.
Warm restrained bed; lift at 275, resolve under the end card.
Close water pour and filter drip.
Low brand sting under the end card.
Disclosed synthetic narration fallback, used only if the performer release cannot be cleared.
Second licensed bed with the same lift and resolve points.

sound.sound_off_message: Captions must carry the message without sound, per MH-07.
sound.notes: Dialogue stays intelligible with the bed ducked; the pour is foley from the single capture session, not a stock effect.
